name: agency-vendor-brief
description: Dùng khi thue NGUOI NGOAI lam — agency, freelancer, production house, vendor: scope of work, spec deliverable, so vong sua, quy trinh duyet, moc thanh toan, dieu khoan IP va bao mat, bang danh gia vendor sau du an. Kích hoạt khi người dùng nhắc 'brief agency', 'thue freelancer', 'quan ly vendor', 'scope of work', 'agency lam khong dung y', 'thue ngoai quay TVC', 'bao gia agency co hop ly khong', 'onboard vendor moi'. Không dùng cho — giao viec cho nhan su noi bo thi dung skill team-brief; chon, tham dinh hoac bao gia KOC rieng le thi dung skill hop-tac-koc-affiliate; brief creator quay UGC hoac KOC da chot thi dung skill brief-ugc-egc; nhan brief tu khach khi CHINH MINH la agency thi dung skill brief-client-intake.
